industryOverview.industryType: Community Healthcare Retail — Primary Care Access Point
industryOverview.summary: UK pharmacy combines regulated medicines supply with expanding clinical services. Community pharmacies are among the most accessible healthcare settings, delivering prescription dispensing, NHS clinical pathways and private health services in local high streets, health centres and increasingly online.

nhsPharmacyModel.name: NHS Community Pharmacy Model
nhsPharmacyModel.description: Contracted via the Community Pharmacy Contractual Framework (CPCF) with NHS England and Community Pharmacy England. Pharmacies dispense NHS prescriptions, deliver Advanced and Enhanced services (Pharmacy First, NMS, contraception, blood pressure checks, vaccinations) and act as a front door to reduce GP and A&E pressure.
nhsPharmacyModel.patientAccess: Walk-in and appointment hybrid; typically longest opening hours in primary care

independentPharmacyModel.name: Independent Pharmacy Model
independentPharmacyModel.description: Single-site or small multi-site businesses owned by pharmacist proprietors. Compete on personal service, local trust, flexible delivery and differentiated private clinics.

smallChainModel.name: Small Chain Model (2–20 branches)
smallChainModel.description: Regional groups sharing branding, procurement and clinical SOPs while retaining local branch identity.

largeChainModel.name: Large Chain Model (national/multiple hundreds)
largeChainModel.description: National operators with standardised formats, central marketing, hub-and-spoke dispensing and high street or supermarket presence.

onlinePharmacyModel.name: Online Pharmacy Model
onlinePharmacyModel.description: Distance-selling pharmacies dispensing via post with digital consultations, repeat prescription apps and private treatment programmes.
characteristics: National reach without physical local presence
limitations: Regulatory advertising constraints on prescription-only medicines

expertise.customerValue: Trusted advice on medicines, interactions and minor illness.

accessibility.description: More pharmacy branches than GP practices; disproportionately serve deprived and rural communities.
accessibility.customerValue: Healthcare within walking distance or short drive.

location.customerValue: Minimal travel burden especially for elderly and chronic patients.
